title: Deadlift
summary: A conventional deadlift from the floor, a full-body pull for the posterior chain, meaning the hamstrings, glutes and back.

setup.text: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and your feet about hip width apart.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your legs, with your back flat and your shoulders over the bar.
Push the floor away and stand up with the bar sliding up your legs.
Lower it back down the same way.

form_cues.cue: Pull the slack out of the bar
Push the floor away with your legs
Lock out with hips and knees together
Keep the bar touching your legs the whole time.

mistakes.text: Letting the hips shoot up first so the back rounds.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where you can fail a rep safely, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
